sam: Heads up — onboarding the sample retriever app and running into inconsistent embedding dims between Node batching helper and our Python SDK. Same input, Node helper returns length 1536, Python returns 1024. Anyone seen this?

jess: Do you have the exact request/response snippets (payload + shape)? model name, endpoint, any headers?

sam: Quick repro:
```
# Node (using batching helper)
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "rwd-embed-v2", "input": ["what is redwood"] }
-> response.embeddings[0].length == 1536

# Python SDK (same text)
client.embeddings.create(model="rwd-embed-v2", input=["what is redwood"])
-> embeddings[0].shape == 1024
```

nina: Interesting. Two quick possibilities: routing fallback to a legacy model variant (different dims) or accidentally hitting the rerank endpoint. Can you check response metadata or X-Model header? The API sometimes returns the actual model variant in headers.

mike: I pulled the sampleapp logs — looks like our batching helper + auth retry interaction is the culprit. Snippet:
```
[2024-05-03T12:34:56Z] attempt=1 id=abc req.model=rwd-embed-v2
[2024-05-03T12:34:57Z] auth refresh -> retry attempt=2 id=abc payload=(input only, model omitted)
[2024-05-03T12:34:58Z] routed to rwd-embed-legacy (legacy returns 1024-d vectors)
[2024-05-03T12:34:58Z] response delivered, client appended vectors for id=abc (duplicate entry)
```
So retries were missing the model field and downstream routing sent them to a fallback model with different dims; plus the helper didn’t dedupe by client id so we got duplicate vectors.

sam: That matches what I see — mismatched dims and duplicate entries in the retriever index. Oof.

jess: Actionable items: (1) SDK/batching helper must preserve model in retry payloads and set an idempotency key for dedupe. (2) Sample apps/docs should run a quick "vector-dim sanity" check on ingest and surface a helpful error (fail early) so users know when models differ. @devex-bot can we make GH issues/notes? :point_up: 

devex-bot: Created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/456 — "preserve-model-on-retry + idempotency for batching helper". Also created docs todo: add vector-dim-check to sample-retriever onboarding.

nina: Short-term workaround for the sampleapp: after getting embeddings, assert expected_dim = 1536 and raise/log with context if mismatch. Example:
```python
expected = 1536
for i, vec in enumerate(embeddings):
    if len(vec) != expected:
        logger.error(f"embed.dim_mismatch idx={i} got={len(vec)} expected={expected}")
        raise ValueError("embedding dimension mismatch — possible model routing fallback")
```
This will prevent silently indexing mixed-dim vectors.

mike: I'll prepare a PR to the Node batching helper: preserve `model` across retries, attach `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` per batch, and add a metric `embed.dim_mismatch` (increment when detection happens). Will link PR to issue #456.

sam: Perfect. I'll freeze sampleapp deploys until the PR lands and update the onboarding checklist to include the dim check. tagging #onboarding for visibility :eyes:. Thanks y'all!
